## Workspaces on the rail

- Each saved workspace is now a button on the left rail, with Home for the tabs outside any workspace. One click switches to it, and the workspace you leave stays connected in the background instead of closing its tabs.
- Ctrl+Shift+1–9 switch by position. The workspace you were looking at reopens at startup.
- Hover a button to see its name, shortcut and state at once. A dot on the button shows new output, a dropped session or an agent waiting in a workspace you're not looking at.
- Right-click a workspace to show it, save it, revert it, change its icon, rename it, close it or delete it. Middle-click closes it, like a tab.
- Switching slides the workspace in from the side of the rail its button is on.

## Saving workspaces

- A workspace's saved layout now changes only when you choose Save workspace. Switching away, closing it or quitting no longer overwrites it, so a tab opened in passing doesn't become part of it.
- Unsaved changes show as a small dot on the button and in its hover card. They survive a restart until you save them or choose Revert to saved.
- Closing a workspace with changes asks whether to save them first.

## Icons

- Workspaces and sessions share one icon set and one picker, with a filter and sections. Type "mysql" and press Enter to pick MySQL.
- New brand icons for databases, containers, clouds, web servers, monitoring and automation tools, alongside the existing operating systems and network vendors.
- Icons are one colour and follow the theme, drawn sharp at every size. The coloured session badges are gone; sessions keep the icons they had.
- A workspace can show its initials (its own, up to three characters) instead of an icon, or as a small label under one, so two workspaces with the same icon still tell apart.
- The session and local profile editors have a new Icon tab. Your own PNG or SVG files in %APPDATA%\Resesh\icons still appear there, under Your icons.

## Settings

- Settings moved from the title bar to the bottom of the left rail. Opening it from another workspace brings its tab to the workspace you're in.

Choose the x64 download for Intel or AMD PCs. Choose ARM64 only for Windows on ARM devices.
